segments.promptText: Cinematic dynamic landscape, strong camera movement, photoreal high detail, no people, no logos, no readable text, no captions. Segment 01 of an 18-part three-minute audiovisual piece. Section: Intro. Scene: pre-dawn mountain valley above cloud, very slow drone push, distant water and fog, warm harmonic light barely appearing. Dominant visual systems: granular tape atmosphere, fog layers, film grain, analog color bleed, drifting dust, warped parallax; warm harmonic architecture, amber and copper light planes, stacked chord-like cliffs, glowing terraces, slow harmonic color changes. Energy level 0.14; camera movement should feel continuous from the previous segment but with a clear new phrase. No humans, no instruments, no UI, no subtitles.
